description: This file defines the BrandedSwitchPreference class, a custom Android preference component extending SwitchPreferenceCompat with branding capabilities, including color theming and view hierarchy traversal to find switch widgets.

classes.name: BrandedSwitchPreference
classes.description: A custom preference class extending SwitchPreferenceCompat that supports branding customization, such as applying a main color to the switch widget.

methods.name: BrandedSwitchPreference
methods.description: Constructors initializing the preference with various parameter sets, setting the widget layout resource.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the view holder, finds the switch widget, and applies branding if a main color is set.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Sets the main color and applies branding to the switch widget.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Private method that applies the branding color to the switch widget if available.

methods.name: findSwitchWidget
methods.description: Recursively searches the view hierarchy to find a MaterialSwitch widget.
